stem:
Rachna looks at the diagram. The marking shows $\triangle GHI \cong \triangle JKL$.

Which claim correctly names the side that corresponds to side $GH$?

teacher.key_rationale: In △GHI ≅ △JKL, G↔J and H↔K, so side GH corresponds to side JK. B shifts to the next side. C stays inside the first triangle. D joins the first and third vertices of the image.
teacher.figure_note: Two congruent triangles GHI and JKL with congruence statement.
